name: RRC-Fork
title: Recursive Resource Calculator (Fork)
author: Herddex, dw3105
description: Fork of Recursive Resource Calculator by Herddex. Pick what to build and how fast: the calculator breaks it down to raw resources and shows machines, rates, energy and pollution per step. Adds quality loops with recyclers, modules and beacons with quality, reprocessing and burning of excess, picker windows and Q copy/paste of machine setups. Open with ALT + X.
